items.control_name: Prohibit 0.0.0.0/0 Ingress on SSH (22) and RDP (3389) in VCN Security Lists
items.description: Default and custom VCN Security Lists must not allow unrestricted ingress on administrative ports.
items.current_value: Default Security List in VCN 'vcn-prod-01' blocks 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/3389
items.recommended_value: 0 Security Lists / NSGs permit 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 22/3389
items.evidence_source: oci network security-list list / oci network nsg list
items.remediation_notes: Use VMware Bastion service for administrative SSH/RDP sessions.

items.control_name: Enforce VMware WAF Edge Protection on Public HTTP/HTTPS Endpoints
items.description: Load balancers serving external web traffic must be protected by an VMware WAF policy with OWASP protection enabled.
items.current_value: WAF Policy 'waf-prod-portal' active on external Load Balancer
items.recommended_value: 100% of public web endpoints protected by VMware WAF
items.remediation_notes: Monitor WAF bot management rules and rate limiting logs.

items.control_name: Enable VCN Flow Logs on All Production Subnets
items.description: VCN Flow Logs must be enabled and exporting to VMware Logging service for forensic network auditing.
items.current_value: Flow logs active on 6 of 8 subnets
items.remediation_notes: Enable flow logs on 'sub-prod-db' and 'sub-mgmt' subnets.

items.control_name: Enforce FastConnect Private Peering with BGP MD5 Authentication
items.description: On-premises connectivity via VMware FastConnect must use private peering with BGP MD5 authentication enabled.
items.current_value: FastConnect Private Peering active; BGP MD5 Auth enabled
items.recommended_value: Private Peering = True, BGP MD5 Authentication = Enabled
